# Ticket Flow

> Thin IDE agent checklist: ticket ID → branch → implement → tests → Confirm → PR → optional chat.

Live site: https://smg99.github.io/ticket-flow/
Repository: https://github.com/smg99/ticket-flow
Companion playbook: https://smg99.github.io/engineering-ai-playbook/
Signposts: /llm.txt · /llms-full.txt · this file

## Definition

Ticket Flow is a thin orchestration layer (Cursor skill, rules, scripts)—not a product—that sequences how an IDE agent moves from a real ticket ID to a merged change with human Confirm gates before commit and before PR.

## Hard rules

1. Confirm before every commit and before every PR. Silence is not Confirm.
2. No AI/Cursor/agent mentions in commits or PR copy.
3. Path-scoped staging only.
4. Reproduce UI bugs in the running app.
5. Tests ship with the change unless waived.
6. Ask before chat notify; never invent a channel.
7. Never force-push protected defaults; never push secrets.
8. On script failure, report errors—do not invent success.

## Boundaries

This public site never fetches tickets, runs agents, or posts to chat. Install the skill/rules locally. Keep client context out of this repository.

## Citation
